rationale: SSRI-to-SNRI switch, particularly useful when comorbid neuropathic pain or chronic musculoskeletal pain favours noradrenergic activity. Sertraline disc risk is moderate; duloxetine titrates slowly. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start duloxetine 30 mg. Hold sertraline 100 mg.
Halve sertraline to 50 mg. Increase duloxetine to 60 mg target.
Reduce sertraline to 25 mg. Hold duloxetine.
Stop sertraline. Continue duloxetine 60 mg. Counsel re duloxetine's high disc risk if later stopped.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: sertraline 100 mg ≈ duloxetine 60 mg (Maudsley 14th). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
